overview.pattern: Clean-room acyclic layered Python 3.12+ toolkit (VFS/SII -> Baseline -> Normalize/Registry/Validate -> Fetch/Package -> Merge/Publish -> CLI; Audit quarantined)
overview.description: MIT / CC BY 4.0 ETS2 1.62+ country realism generator and combo composer in src/ets2_realism/ (73 modules across 11 subpackages + cli.py, 45 pytest suites, 3 GitHub workflows). Builds Summer/Winter Vanilla+DLC Core mods, offline ProMods Editions (EU+ME+MA+TGS), and local map-combo patches (zz_ETS2_Realism_ComboPatch_{Summer,Winter}.scs) from 225-territory laws and live/locked fuel & FX data.

data-flow.flow: 1.62 baseline + 225 law JSONs + 3-tier fuel/FX APIs -> state/prices.lock.json -> v1 RealismSnapshot -> Core/ProMods/Combo compiler + Zero-DDS totems -> Offline SCS Validator -> Phase A Release PR
data-flow.description: fetch updates state/prices.lock.json (151 currencies, 225 territories); registry resolves seasonal DST via zoneinfo+tzdata into schema_version=1 realism-snapshot-{summer,winter}.json + SHA256SUMS.txt; package/merge synthesize country .sui, speed_limits.sii, Zero-DDS sign boards, and 43-locale fuel modules; validate checks SCS 00001-00010 + license taint before publish updates state/published.json.

conventions.naming: Package ets2-country-realism (import ets2_realism, CLI ets2-realism); snake_case modules/functions, PascalCase strict frozen Pydantic v2 models; SCS unit segments strictly [a-z0-9_]{1,12} (.ets2r_fuel, @@fp_*_ets2r@@)
conventions.file-organization: src/ets2_realism/{vfs,sii,baseline,registry,normalize,fetch,package,validate,publish,merge,audit}/ + cli.py; data/{baselines/ets2_1.62_def,laws/countries (225),mappings,curated}/; state/{prices.lock.json,published.json}; assets/icons/ (4 JPEGs); tests/test_*.py (45 suites)
conventions.imports: from __future__ import annotations; basedpyright strict + Ruff (E,F,I,UP,B,SIM,RUF, line-length=100); deterministic UTF-8 no-BOM LF JSON/SII and fixed-timestamp ZIPs

license-boundary.rule: MIT (code) / CC BY 4.0 (data & snapshots) clean-room boundary with automated taint gate
license-boundary.description: Zero GPL extractors, zero 3nK/AEM! decryption, zero CC BY-NC-ND (GlobalPetrolPrices), MyLPG, paid IEA, or CC BY-SA/ODbL OSM data in data/, state/, snapshots, or packages. Enforced by src/ets2_realism/audit/taint.py, src/ets2_realism/validate/invariants.py, and tests/test_license_taint_gate.py.

field-ownership-policy.description: FieldOwnershipPolicy separates realism overlays (fuel_price, lights_mandatory, driving_tired_offence, car/truck/bus speed_limits) from map geometry/identity (country_id, pos, regions[]/region_areas[], train/tram speeds, leftside_traffic, imperial_units, country_code). Uses max_of_map_and_real monotonic axle-limit merging and patch_if_single_tz DST shifting (preserving multi-TZ Russia/Kazakhstan/Brazil).

zero-dds-totems.description: Option 4b Zero-DDS totems forbid .dds/.tobj outputs; rewrite def/sign/board/*.sii with @@fp_*_ets2r@@ tokens and emit synchronized locale/<lang>/local_module.ets2r_fuel.sii across all 43 active 1.62 locales with glyph/width verification, national formats (EUR/tenth-cent <sup>9</sup>/pence/integers), ProMods pm_fuel/pm_me_fuel/pm_tgs_fuel modules, and opt-in --patch-hardcoded-totems for JRR/7RM.

promods-ip-boundary.description: Option C IP boundary: zero ProMods .scs/def files in Git or CI. Public CI ships Vanilla+DLC Core and SHA256SUMS-verified snapshots; ProMods Editions (EU+ME+MA+TGS) and compose-local run offline on user archives with assert_out_dir_not_tracked and automatic managed-package self-exclusion (# ets2-realism:managed-package).

three-tier-fuel-fx-pipeline.description: Multi-provider FX validation (Frankfurter v2, ECB XML, fawazahmed0 CC0, CBR XML across 151 currencies) + 3-tier fuel acquisition: Tier 1 EU/Global gov APIs (EC WOB, UK/NO/FR/DE/ES/IT/NL, US/BR/AR/CO/CL/MY/JP/KR), Tier 2 10 guarded portals, Tier 3 186 curated baselines (data/curated/tier3_fuel_baselines.json). Circuit breakers (0.01-5.00 EUR/L, +/-25% WoW alert) fall back to prices.lock.json.

offline-scs-validator.description: Offline validator enforcing SCS Workshop Uploader rules (00001-00010, WARN 00001/00002, 276x162 JPEG icon, mp_mod_optional: true, no .dds/.tobj/non-asset files, SII hygiene, 43-locale parity, license taint) across core/promods/combo profiles.

phase-a-publishing.description: Semi-auto Friday 06:00 UTC CI with zero Steam secrets: fetches FX/fuel, builds & validates Core packages and v1 snapshots, SHA-256 diff-gates against state/published.json, updates rolling snapshots-latest Release, and upserts release/phase-a-weekly PR for manual Workshop upload.

quarantined-osm-audit.description: One-way internal CI audit (zero imports from audit into build/package/publish/merge/registry/fetch). Monthly read-only job diffs data/laws/ vs westnordost/osm-legal-default-speeds (+ opt-in Overpass <=10 ISO-2s & Taginfo v4) using data/laws/speed_audit_allowlist.json (11 entries) and upserts/auto-closes rolling osm-audit GitHub Issue.

component:VFS-SII-Baseline.responsibility: Read-only HashFS v1/v2 (CityHash64 1.0.3), ZIP, and Dir VFS stack with AEM!/3nK refusal; span-preserving SiiDocument + country/speed_limits/sign_board/localization parsers; ETS2 1.62.3.3 baseline extractor (36 countries, 461 fuel boards, 43 locales).

component:Registry-Package-Merge.responsibility: 225-territory law registry, 119-alias resolver, IANA DST resolver, v1 snapshots, 276x162 icon generator, Core/ProMods/compose-local builders (game.log/profile.sii/modlist load-order, --unpacked-defs protected-archive substitution, FieldOwnershipPolicy, Zero-DDS totems).
